---
title: "Stage 3b: NTD Capital Expenses – unified agency-year panel 2014-2024"
---

```{r}
#| label: purpose
#| include: false
# =============================================================================
# Purpose : Build a tidy agency-year panel of NTD total capital expenditure.
# Sources :
#   Capital:
#     2014-2021: data/raw/ntd/capital_use_YYYY.xlsx
#     2022-2024: data/raw/ntd/ntd_capital_socrata_raw.csv (Socrata fphd-jyyj)
#   Agency directory (city/state per ntd_id):
#     2014-2024: data/raw/ntd/agency_info_YYYY.xlsx  (FTA Annual Database
#                Agency Information; the official agency-year directory)
# Output  : data/cleaned/ntd_transit.rds
#   Columns: ntd_id, agency_name, city, state, year, total_capital_usd
# =============================================================================
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
here::i_am("_quarto.yml")
```

## Read 2014-2021 xlsx files

```{r}
#| label: xlsx
# Column-name normalization – 2014 uses different headers than 2017+
pick_first <- function(df, candidates) {
  for (c in candidates) if (c %in% names(df)) return(df[[c]])
  rep(NA_character_, nrow(df))
}

read_xlsx_year <- function(yr) {
  f <- here("data", "raw", "ntd", sprintf("capital_use_%d.xlsx", yr))
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(tibble())
  sheets <- excel_sheets(f)
  sheet <- sheets[str_detect(sheets, regex("capital.?use", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
  if (is.na(sheet)) sheet <- sheets[1]
  # Text col_types so Reduced/Rural Reporter string ntd_ids (e.g., "0R02-00308")
  # are not lost when read against an inferred-numeric column.
  d <- suppressWarnings(read_excel(f, sheet = sheet, col_types = "text")) |>
    janitor::clean_names()

  tibble(
    year              = yr,
    ntd_id            = pick_first(d, c("ntd_id", "x5_digit_ntdid", "x5_digit_ntd_id")),
    legacy_ntd_id     = pick_first(d, c("legacy_ntd_id", "x4_digit_ntdid", "x4_digit_ntd_id")),
    agency_name       = pick_first(d, c("agency_name", "reporter_name")),
    total_capital_usd = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pick_first(d, c("total_capital_funds", "total"))))
  ) |>
    filter(!is.na(total_capital_usd), total_capital_usd > 0) |>
    group_by(year, ntd_id, legacy_ntd_id, agency_name) |>
    summarise(total_capital_usd = sum(total_capital_usd), .groups = "drop")
}

ntd_xlsx <- map_dfr(2014:2021, read_xlsx_year)
cat("xlsx years loaded:", paste(sort(unique(ntd_xlsx$year)), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("xlsx agency-year rows:", nrow(ntd_xlsx), "\n")
```

## Read 2022-2024 Socrata CSV

```{r}
#| label: socrata
so <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "ntd", "ntd_capital_socrata_raw.csv"),
               show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  janitor::clean_names()
# Columns of interest: year column, ntd_id, agency, city, state, total
ntd_socrata <- so |>
  transmute(
    year              = as.integer(report_year),
    ntd_id            = as.character(ntd_id),
    agency_name       = as.character(agency),
    city              = as.character(city),
    state             = as.character(state),
    total_capital_usd = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(total))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(total_capital_usd), total_capital_usd > 0) |>
  group_by(year, ntd_id, agency_name, city, state) |>
  summarise(total_capital_usd = sum(total_capital_usd), .groups = "drop")

cat("Socrata years loaded:", paste(sort(unique(ntd_socrata$year)), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Socrata agency-year rows:", nrow(ntd_socrata), "\n")
```

## Read agency-info files (FTA Annual Database Agency Information)

```{r}
#| label: agency-info
# Force text col_types: in some years (notably 2020) ntd_id is read as numeric,
# which NAs out Reduced/Rural Reporters with string IDs like "0R02-00308".
read_agency_info <- function(yr) {
  f <- here("data", "raw", "ntd", sprintf("agency_info_%d.xlsx", yr))
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(tibble())
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(f)
  d <- suppressWarnings(readxl::read_excel(f, sheet = sheets[1],
                                           col_types = "text")) |>
    janitor::clean_names()
  tibble(
    year             = yr,
    ntd_id           = pick_first(d, c("ntd_id", "x5_digit_ntdid",
                                       "x5_digit_ntd_id", "x5_digit_id")),
    legacy_ntd_id    = pick_first(d, c("legacy_ntd_id", "x4_digit_ntdid",
                                       "x4_digit_ntd_id", "x4_digit_id")),
    agency_name      = pick_first(d, c("agency_name", "reporter_name")),
    city             = pick_first(d, c("city", "agency_city", "reporter_city",
                                       "hq_city", "p_city")),
    state            = pick_first(d, c("state", "agency_state", "reporter_state",
                                       "hq_state", "p_state")),
    organization_type = pick_first(d, c("organization_type",
                                        "institutional_structure",
                                        "organization_type_description"))
  ) |>
    filter(!is.na(ntd_id) | !is.na(legacy_ntd_id))
}

agency_info <- map_dfr(2014:2024, read_agency_info)
cat("Agency-info rows (all years):", nrow(agency_info), "\n")
cat("Distinct ntd_ids:           ", n_distinct(agency_info$ntd_id), "\n")
cat("Rows with city + state:     ",
    sum(!is.na(agency_info$city) & !is.na(agency_info$state)), "\n")
```

## Attach city/state to pre-2022 rows via agency-info crosswalk

```{r}
#| label: crosswalk
# Legacy <-> 5-digit ntd_id crosswalk from BOTH agency_info (best) and capital xlsx
# (fallback for the rare legacy_ntd_id that only appears in capital files).
legacy_xwalk <- bind_rows(
  agency_info |>
    filter(!is.na(ntd_id), !is.na(legacy_ntd_id)) |>
    distinct(ntd_id, legacy_ntd_id),
  ntd_xlsx |>
    filter(!is.na(ntd_id), !is.na(legacy_ntd_id)) |>
    distinct(ntd_id, legacy_ntd_id)
) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(legacy_ntd_id, ntd_id) |>
  group_by(legacy_ntd_id) |> slice(1) |> ungroup()

# Fill ntd_id on pre-2017 xlsx rows (where only legacy was present)
ntd_xlsx <- ntd_xlsx |>
  left_join(legacy_xwalk |> rename(ntd_id_from_legacy = ntd_id),
            by = "legacy_ntd_id") |>
  mutate(ntd_id = coalesce(ntd_id, ntd_id_from_legacy)) |>
  select(-ntd_id_from_legacy)

# (year, ntd_id) -> city, state from the year-specific agency-info file.
# Falls back to any other year for the same ntd_id when the precise year is missing.
ai_yearly <- agency_info |>
  filter(!is.na(ntd_id), !is.na(city) | !is.na(state)) |>
  distinct(year, ntd_id, city, state)

ai_any <- agency_info |>
  filter(!is.na(ntd_id)) |>
  group_by(ntd_id) |>
  summarise(city_any  = first(na.omit(city)),
            state_any = first(na.omit(state)),
            .groups = "drop")

ntd_xlsx2 <- ntd_xlsx |>
  left_join(ai_yearly |> rename(city_y = city, state_y = state),
            by = c("year", "ntd_id")) |>
  left_join(ai_any, by = "ntd_id") |>
  mutate(city  = coalesce(city_y, city_any),
         state = coalesce(state_y, state_any)) |>
  select(year, ntd_id, agency_name, city, state, total_capital_usd)

cat("Pre-2022 capital rows with city matched via agency-info:",
    sum(!is.na(ntd_xlsx2$city)), "of", nrow(ntd_xlsx2), "\n")
cat("Pre-2022 capital rows with state matched via agency-info:",
    sum(!is.na(ntd_xlsx2$state)), "of", nrow(ntd_xlsx2), "\n")
```

## Combine

```{r}
#| label: combine
ntd <- bind_rows(
  ntd_xlsx2,
  ntd_socrata |> select(year, ntd_id, agency_name, city, state, total_capital_usd)
) |>
  arrange(year, ntd_id)

cat("Full NTD panel – years:\n")
print(ntd |> count(year))
cat("\nUnique agencies:", n_distinct(ntd$ntd_id), "\n")
cat("Rows with city/state:", sum(!is.na(ntd$city) & !is.na(ntd$state)), "/", nrow(ntd), "\n")
```

## Write capital panel + agency directory

```{r}
#| label: write
out <- here("data", "cleaned", "ntd_transit.rds")
saveRDS(ntd, out)
cat(sprintf("Wrote %s – %d rows\n", out, nrow(ntd)))
```

```{r}
#| label: agency-directory
# Agency-level directory: one row per ntd_id with the most recent agency_name +
# organization_type observed. `local_controlled` is TRUE only for the
# "City, County or Local Government Unit or DOT" org-type category.

local_controlled_orgs <- c(
  "City, County or Local Government Unit or Department of Transportation"
)

agency_directory <- agency_info |>
  filter(!is.na(ntd_id)) |>
  group_by(ntd_id) |>
  arrange(desc(year), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  summarise(
    agency_name       = first(na.omit(agency_name)),
    organization_type = first(na.omit(organization_type)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(local_controlled = organization_type %in% local_controlled_orgs)

saveRDS(agency_directory, here("data", "cleaned", "agency_directory.rds"))
cat(sprintf("Wrote agency_directory.rds – %d agencies (%d locally controlled)\n",
            nrow(agency_directory),
            sum(agency_directory$local_controlled)))
cat("\nOrganization-type distribution:\n")
print(agency_directory |> count(organization_type, sort = TRUE))
```
